description: The file appears to be a server-side PHP script responsible for rendering an HTML page with embedded JavaScript for configuring DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) settings on a router or network device. It includes form handling, UI initialization, validation, and AJAX submission logic.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses and expands abbreviated IPv6 addresses into full 8-part notation.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks whether form inputs for IPv4 or IPv6 addresses are blank.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates the parts of an IPv4 or IPv6 address from form inputs.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address inputs are required based on their blank status.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 address inputs are required based on their blank status.

methods.name: populate_IPv6
methods.description: Auto-fills IPv6 address fields based on the IPv6 prefix.

methods.name: saveQoS
methods.description: Sends the DMZ configuration data to the server via AJAX for saving.
